casr._alignment_comment: Mirrors deploy/real_lmcache_pd/router_config.json: the same FlowSolverConfig keys with the same semantics.  prefill/decode_service_ms are the single-request service times implied by each instance's capacity at the run's --max-num-seqs 64 (service_ms = 1000 * max_num_seqs / capacity), so compute_weight prices per-unit compute the way the real control loop does.
casr._service_comment: prefill/decode service_ms and capacities are Qwen3-8B placeholders: rescale_service_times/rescale_capacities overwrite them from profiler/perf/<HW>/casr/P15B/bf16.

_comment: P-15B (casr/P15B) on the same three-domain topology as casr_real_qwen3_8b_three_domain.json, so the two are directly comparable: same nodes, same links, same instances -- only the model and its KV geometry differ. kv_bytes_per_token is the design's closed form (16960 B = 16.56 KB/token, docs/DSV4-P15B设计.md 5), against 147456 B for Qwen3-8B.  |  Single-domain cut of casr_p15b_three_domain.json (RTX4090 only, 1P+1D): used to check that a real P-15B bundle is consumed end to end before the other three domains land.
